authority.scope: Authorized existing internal/quantlab research request validation and direct API/UI tests only; not engine algorithm, authority, capital execution or deployment.

contract.requiredName: Trimmed nonempty, at most 80 UTF-16 code units; original accepted name preserved
contract.seed: Signed JS-safe integer; omitted and explicit zero remain zero
contract.cost: Nonnegative JS-safe integer fee/slippage; zero remains valid; no new fee model
contract.windows: fast >= 2, slow > fast, JS-safe integers; explicit invalid values rejected
contract.http: 400 invalid_research_parameters with existing requestId/errorId; research decoder rejects explicit null and duplicate case-insensitive fields and retains unknown-field rejection
contract.publicInvalidRequest: Reject before market history read/workspace creation
contract.ui: Research-only typed error localization for all 12 languages; prior result preserved, no automatic retry

tests.result: FAIL: explicit illegal parameters accepted/persisted; effective defaults not returned

intermediateTestFailure: Snapshot deep equality initially included fresh read-time asOf/sourceMetadata.asOf. Regression now excludes only these observation timestamps and compares all remaining fields including persisted audit; no production assertion weakened.
localFixtureBoundary: Chrome and HTTP tests use synthetic loopback fixtures and local-paper capability IDs. Two tenants/two processes, twelve same-key submissions, conflict, restart/reopen and replay are local evidence, not real wallet auth or PostgreSQL/public trading evidence.

build.format: Mach-O arm64 developer executable, NOT installer or production artifact

handoff: A final release owner integrates only these ordinary deltas with compatible authority/asset graph; do not replace whole app.js or workspace. No independent deployment. Rollback is source reversion of this scoped commit through release owner, not a production mutation.
remaining: Compatible official build and release-owner publication
Source-bound public/native API and visible research save/reopen verification
Research arithmetic at extreme otherwise safe numeric magnitudes is not certified by this request-validation change
